The airport was shining new and clean with clear signs and directions both in Vietnamese and English The international departure was smooth though queuing time for immigration and security screening was a bit long due to the jam in the morning Not many dutyfree shopping compared to some other international airports in SEA Dining was expensive seemed the restaurant was trying to make money from tourists Boarding gate was good with a lot of seats Toilet was clean

BDL is my hometown airport I found plenty of kiosks for checkin at US Airways and went through security quickly On the airside at US Airways gates very limited options in terms of stores and restaurants and the good shopsrestaurants are at the other side of the terminal Upon return finding luggage is easy and the pickup for valet lots is fast the amenities are limited but the airport is streamlined and easy to use I prefer BDL plus connection to a direct flight from BOS or JFK anytime
Hatay HTY I flew into Hatay last year for my daughters wedding celebration airport was small but adequate and staff were helpful

ITO is absolutely lovely I flew in HNLITO and out ITOOGG Outdoor type airport and probably the most easytouse airport I have ever had the pleasure of using Very tropical theme Car rentals are right across the street from curbside pickup Checking in is very easy for those using Island Air There is a restaurant in the middle that gets very busy during breakfast so get there early if you dont want to stand in a line that goes out the door

Hiroshimas airport is somewhat small but is intelligently laid out and easy to navigate Perhaps because of its relative newness it appears to be quite pristine inside with a good range of services for travellers The biggest drawback is the distance from Hiroshima city well over a half hour outside of the city As another reviewer noted the IBEX flight requires walking out onto the tarmac which could be a hassle in inclement weather

The current airport is small but efficient A new much larger terminal is being build Border and security control was fast and efficient All gates are currently in one large terminal with bus boarding only Staff was acting friendly and speedy Bus brings you to to city in for only Lei

Waiting area is too far from the entrance a lot of mosquitos in waiting area as its open crowded too My flight at am and I arrived long hours before my flight in which they decided to let me stay in waiting area overnight and mosquitos enjoying to eat you alive Please do something

Massive improvement in airport and staff Very clean public facilities are well maintained Staff are a bit friendlier now and fewer queues on departure and arrival securityimmigration clearance due to having extra staff on counters Just need a few more shops in the terminal
Beautiful airport in Orange County with incredible ease to all major interstates Airport sits off the and is perfectly situated for Los Angeles visitors Large airport with a small town feel

This is my preferred airport in SoCal for arriving atdeparting from which I do on a regular basis Big enough to offer connections anywhere in the US for flights to Europe yet small enough offer a quick friendly and efficient service tofrom your gate Drop off facilities outside the terminals needs to be improved but apart from that no real complaints

Since my last review Karlsruhe airport has improved beyond expectations Regular flights to more destinations and vastly improved bus services to Baden and Rastatt Eating and shopping facilities need to be improved especially on Sundays when the duty free shop and gate one bar are generally closed
The airport is very small however the staff provided a very good service We went through the airport very quickly
This airport was very efficient no lines or delayed services There are a lot of shops where you can shop and places where you can have a bite Delicious coffee and bakery items to buy

One of the better airports in Africa I made use of the pay lounge at USD where they served snacks and drinks I had a medical situation was referred to the medical station and received good medical attention

Fast efficient little airport to arrive at your luggage arrives quickly and is usually carefully handled It is almost impossible to get lost and the airport has good transport links for Carinthia and the ski regions of NW Slovenia Flying from Klagenfurt is not quite so good the departure lounge could do with some toilets after passport control so if you need the toilet be sure to go before you go through On the positive side the cafe upstairs is very good for the size of airport

From the first step of the airplane at Koh Samui Airport I felt that I was in a tropical paradise It was not a standard airport bus but a train of small wagons painted in bright colours Airport is a complex of many small buildings in Thai style connected by open galleries A lot of open space just covered with roof from rain Many trees and flowers Even an aquarium in WC There are minibuses for transfer to Samui hotels and of course you can take an individual taxi with fixed price

A modern medium size airport with ample space airside got plenty of outlets at the departure area and efficient checkin counter The airport is near to the city centre and it is easy to reach by taxi and private transportation Once through the security check you will be greeted by an airy airside with an ample seating area near to the gate and due to the design of the terminal the distance of the gate is really short and gave ample time for the passenger to catch their flight

Small airport only serves a couple of airlines Landing process was pretty fast seem the airport does not have air bridges Bags delivered pretty fast Check in at airport was fine many dining options Security check was fast Not sure about transportation options because we were picked up and dropped off by our hotel It is a very sufficient regional airport

Good airport with facilities to cater for the number of flights Slight delays on arrival due to fruit and vegetable quarantine but no problem read the notices and listen to the announcements makes it easy It does the job

Ive flown in and out of BJX a half dozen times and have no problems Take along a book or knitting as there are only a couple of souvenir shops but they are colorful and reasonable My destination has been San Miguel de Allende the art colony thats popular with US citizens

This is a small and nice airport Ive landed and departed from this airport before and it has changed a lot I dont know why it is called Leon Airport if it is closer to Silao Gto I landed there a few months ago my destination was Romita Gto my mothers hometown This airport is very convenient for us since it is only about mins away from Romita Also this airport is not very far from Guanajuato city I recommend people to visit Guanajuato this is perhaps the most European style city in Mexico

I travel from Limoges to and from Paris The terminal is a little bit small but it is very clean There is a not a very long queue time and the staff were very proactive At this airport there is one bar and one restaurant but there are no lounges or dutyfree The boarding area is very small and there is not much seating This is a little but very efficient airport

Excellent little airport A bit tired cosmetically but everyone was friendly and everything worked seamlessly Dont rush through security unless youre desperate to look at aeroplanes as theres not much else to do Theres a little smoking box that takes people after security next to gate upstairs Its free and the ventilation works well

It is simply an airport and not trying to be a shopping mall or anything else Very quick passage through the airport if youre only dropping off bags TSA efficient but thorough bit of a crowd in the north portakabin as JetBlue DL and AS had simultaneous departures but as you can turn up so close to departure its not a long wait Restaurant upstairs is good as well though not cheap and it would be good to have more of the balcony given to noneaters maybe its busier midweek than on a Sunday afternoon

The addition of the new Southwest wing has been a good improvement for all those who enjoy flying on this airline Flying out of this airport has been very convenient because of its location for many Long islanders especially those living in Suffolk and eastern Nassau counties The one drawback to the Southwest facility expansion is the distance from their new gates to the baggage claims area

A brand new airport which is large and spacious but lacking in facilities Our gate was in an area where there is no catering and no access to a part of the airside where we could even get a coffee Staff are not all that friendly here but it seems to be efficient with little queuing though not all the many flights either
I would like to thank Alessandra at the customer services desk for the phenomenal service and friendliness she has provided me at the airport She is an absolute gem

Optimal infrastructure parking is good the check in is very fast thoughtful attendants the security is good The airport has a lack of restaurants that is somewhat annoying but has a good service and good wifi
This is a well designed airport There is no hassle from porters and taxi operators Checking in is very fast and efficient Arrival luggage handling is very good
The airport services were very attentive to the plane we arrived at local time when we left the plane the luggage gang was already in operation and the suitcases were in very good condition

First time arriving in this beautiful country together with wife for umrah Arrived by Malaysia Airlines A and departure with same aircraft Facilities well kept staff welcome us with a smile Easy flow for arriving and departing

This is possibly one of the nicest airports Ive flown through Staff were amiable the terminals were clean and wellmaintained and everything was wellmarked Security was a breeze and the baggage claim system is both swift and efficient compared to other airports

The new airport in Miri is a blessing to all of us frequent travellers Although it is small it is efficient clean and cool If anything needs to be imroved on is the charges we have to pay for a small cup of coffee or a meal The charges are much too high for a domestic airport

We travelled through Monastir Airport and found it to be pretty good for a small airport The queues coming in were fairly smooth and on the way out of the country everything went smoothly as well Facilities are perhaps a little limited but its only a small airport comparatively and at least it was clean

I agree most strongly that passport control is a nightmare I could not believe the length of time it takes to get passengers through and especially when the airport is so hot and lacked air conditioning I have visited this Airport twice now and hope that in future they can implement a more effective way of getting through control The rest of the airport was fine and even homeward bound found it was comfortably set out with refreshments and enjoyed a last encounter of some traditional Tunisian retail shops

Montgomery Regional Airport Dannelly Field has been completely modernized and is one of the most attractive small airports in the US Checkin in close to the curb and security is efficient Food and drink groundside and airside is basic Deplaning is easy and baggage claim is close to the street Parking is reasonably convenient unless you are travelling mid week It can be a longish walk to the terminal

A small yet very convenient airport in the south of France From the plane to the exit takes no more than min Signaling shopping etc is all fine given the size and role of the airport Its not the most modern airport but everything is well maintained Theres a convenient bus service to the city center

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well

We were delayed for nights due to bad weather on the th and th January The staff at Mytilene Airport in Lesbos were excellent they kept a smile during a very difficult time for them We were given a voucher for food and drinks each time our flight was cancelled times in all and they sent us to very good hotels both nights In addition when we asked if they could extend our journey for the days that we had lost they did with no problems

The airport is very new and modern I have flown through this airport multiple times but this is the first time at the new terminal It is a lot larger than the original terminal There was finally free WiFi and it was pretty fast considering the internet in China It was mainly based off of Shanghai Pudong the airport I was actually flying to and had the identical announcement system that PVG terminal had Although there were a few foreigners including me it felt very open and very welcoming

Lives up to its name no signs chaos rude airport staff overflowing rubbish bins of flight delayed and no aircon but great food Unless one wants to fly to Rome and drive not many options to visit Campania and it is worth visiting so just have to roll with it and accept it

Modern airport medium in Chinese terms Incoming by bus from runway efficient and fast very simple to get your bearings Outgoing fast very clear information very efficient checkin good facilities About min from city center

A friendly airport if you just want to watch the planes from the viewing area but not passenger friendly poor layout Up a lot of stairs for passport checks when you arrive Had to go through security the past twice on departure the both times they claimed I had passed through a public area after the first check Security patdowns are embarrassingly intimate

Nuremberg is an amazingly convenient and fast airport You get there easily by public transportation from the metro station to check in its not even one minute walking and you can be at your gate within minutes of arriving Baggage delivery is quick mostly your baggage is already at the conveyor belt when you get there

A small airport where you can go from the luggage checkin to the gate within minutes There were enough places to sit down and the WiFi is good If you want to eat something before the security there is a restaurant with enough food pricequality top After the security you can also drink or eat something Boarding goes quickly

Ottawa is my home airport and given the population that it serves its very convenient It is not very large so it may not have some of the amenities larger airports will have showers multiple lounges etc but its fast clean and provides an acceptable amount of food choices Whenever possible I like to clear customs in this airport vs doing so in Toronto or Montreal

PSP is a beautiful airport in the secured area However the checkin to the security point is a long walk for the many retired people that travel through this airport The open air feeling is great in this warm climate The biggest negative is that when there is poor weather and those times are few is the lack of technology for pilots to land During a rain storm and low visibility we were delayed minutes while circling and then continued to Los Angelos then bussed back to Palm Springs

I arrived at PSP from SFO I have used the airport from time to time in the past It is quite capable of coping with its traffic but has experienced one major improvement whereby hired cars can now be collected on site This is very welcome especially when the heat is high

Transited twice in November without problems Signage is good distances are large even within terminal e No problems either time though timings were circa an hour and a half Security check each time but fairly fast and efficient

Paro International Airport is located meter above sea level so flights can only fly in the morning I took a Druk Air flight from Bangkok and the other time I took a flight from Kathmandu I prefer flying from Kathmandu because I could see Himalayan Mountains if the weather permits Paro Airport has very basic amenities because they have two carriers flying in and out It replicated Bhutanese traditional architecture and it looked very beautiful as I was walking into the airport

The airport is small and modern It has both local and international flights Air France Arrivals are no problem and there is not far to walk from the aircraft to the airport exit There did not seem to be to many people bothering passengers Departures is also straight forward with modern checkin desks There are not many shops in the departure area and only one basic cafe There is adequate seating and the airconditioning works well Overall a very good experience compared with other African airports

A quiet afternoon at PDX Short queues to get through security with efficient and helpful staff As the space allocated for security was fairly small I can imagine at that at busy times there could be problems
Quick lines through security and it is a better option than flying out of Logan with the longer lines Airport restaurantsbars are limited but OK for all the longer that you will be there

Small airport dealing mostly with flights within Canada and USA Security was quick and easy no language problems either and we were through into the departure lounge which only has a shop and cafe but does have good free wifi to give you something to do while you wait A good experience
Love Quebecs airport Small but offers all of the facilities in a big airport Not too much people

One of the nicest most modern airports in the country Decent array of shops and restaurants Not a large selection between security checkpoints and departure gates but that is typical and here it is still far better than at Fortaleza a city of similar size Airport is close to town especially beach areas so transportation is usually easy How many agents are actually working at the checkin counters can vary widely but I assume that is the responsibility of the airlines

Its a small airport at an island abt km from Rijeka Checking in and out goes quite fast at our experience Some staff members in the shop are kind of grumpy Nevertheless we are very happy with this airport how they have arranged a hotel in Opatija for our group when our flight was cancelled all of a sudden in the evening Our flight company Transavia told some people to find and book by themselves a hotel but the airport arranged bus transport and a luxurious hotel so our compliments

A supposedly international city airport and in the huge transit area the managers dont even manage to install a few water fountains for cool refreshing water for tired and thirsty travellers especially those with children What an appalling omission It is a shame really as in most other respects the airport is very pleasant

A small little provincial airport can be a touch uncomfortable in hot weather as the large glass windows absorb the sun as you wait in the departure area One small cafe serving reasonable food and drink Check in quick and car hire points convenient to main entrance Good main road access to the town of Rodez and Tarn and Tarn et Garonne etc

Leonardo da Vinci Fiumicino Airport is a huge welldesigned welldecorated airport with clean and huge facilities I waited there for hours as the checkin security check and immigration were completed early However I spent good time as the airport facilities made easy travelers to navigate and browse for shopping and restaurants Airport staffs were good They speak English well Only bad thing is that travelers have to walk long to get into the boarding bridges

As I live nearby its a convenient airport for me especially because of frequent flights to London and Southern France You can make use of free Internet Parking is cheap Connection to Rotterdam City and Port area is good and quick Hardly any queuing you can arrive mins before departure without any problems Whenever possible I make use of RotterdamThe Hague Airport
Small airport with few but good services Reasonable time to check in and pass passport checks Excessively expensive duty free It offers a good free wifi service also available outside the air side

Interesting experience This airport is very close to the city mainly for domestic flights and is extremely busy However even though really crowded all queues seem to move very quickly A reasonable mix of retail outlets and I thought the prices were OK Plenty on taxis on return there are prepay ones but for journeys into the city a metered cab is fine

Its very small but convenient airport There is small duty free area and coffee bar in upper floor after immigration and also one coffee bar before immigration Toilets are clean Immigration procedures on arrival and on departure are simple and fast

It is a privilege to be able to travel via GMP in Seoul Not because the airport is extraordinary but because it is within the city of Seoul and much closer then the island of Incheon GMP can be be reached by metro It is a domestic and an international airport the international connections are through towards Asian destinations GMP has the Advantages and the disadvantages of an old city airport easy to reach more efficient security procedures but old facilities like lounges

This is a small but friendly airport The checkin area is not air conditioned and is hot Checkin was efficient immigration and security were efficient with hardly any queues In departures there were two food and drink outlets a dutyfree shop and several other shops Boarding was efficient
The pleasant experience of arriving and departure in Shannon Airport was above all else Efficiency professionalism courteous Dublin needs to take a look and see how its done Well done Shannon

Beautiful terminal and concourses in the new terminal Light and airy honestly the airport I would most enjoy waiting around in for a flight delay Also good food and shops and a general uplifting feeling Also the bus transit link back to Hong Kong was fast and efficient Going through security screening was a bit of a line but the check procedure was quick enough

Two years on from my last report and improvements continue to happen The check in area has been updated making for a comfortable experience and the new TSA security area is large and works efficiently A new hotel is now connected directly to the terminal Staff as usual friendly and helpful Forced to deduct one point for the lack of baggage carts If they are there they are well hidden

From the city to the airport in minutes The new terminal is fine Beautiful geometric lines used in the design Checkin for flight did not take too long The old building renovated and converted into a zone of local flights There are many shops and cafes There was a small queue of precontrol before departure

Stavanger airport Sola is a small airport like the one in Bergen and Trondheim Not many international flights but quite many domestic The terminal there is only one is years old but they have started to upgrade everything All in all a comfortable airport

Modern and easy to use No queues to speak of Firefly the main user are efficient and a cheaper alternative to flying Malaysian out of KLIA However beware transfer times from downtown KL especially during morning and evening peak times even more so on MondaysFridays Although nearer to the city centre than KLIA it can and did in my case take longer to get to Subang mins than it would have taken to get to KLIA

The airport was a bit far from the city but well connected to the public transportation with clear signs and direction It was in general clean Queuing time at the immigration was not too long for us As many other Asian international airports TPE was full of restaurants and a shopping paradise for passengers to kill waiting time Each boarding gate had a different theme and sometimes did not have enough seats for everyone
There is very good food and Wifi Internet The dutyfree shop has all kinds of brands and it is cheaper than neighboring countries The immigration inspection is fast and not difficult

I forgot my prescription glasses in the Duty Free in Tbilisi Following a few emails to the Duty Free department I received a positive response that they were found Two ladies did everything in their power to have them returned to me I cant fault these people they showed care and sympathy to my problems They are Natia and Inna Thank you so much

A small airport divided into mini terminals domestic international arrival and international departure Border control was fast and efficient despite the large amount of passengers The terminals itself are clean and well maintained but rather s looking Access to the aircraft is by bus boarding only There are many taxis to the center but negotiate well A few busses are available too but look like from a museum
Phenomenal airport the best I ever experienced in Europe or anywhere else Just the material definition of how an airport should be Well done Albania

The little airport is getting a lot more traffic and starting to burst at the seams Even though the rail connection is a good piece of news the amount of people in the transit area isnt But still it beats Stansted queuing and even Ryanair checkin is fairly straight forward
The security staff at Townsville Airport are the most friendliest efficient and personable I never dread having to go through screening at this airport pity Brisbane AP doesnt operate as efficiently

A very small airport that mainly serves Trieste Udine Gorizia and the western part of Slovenia More similar to a train station as it often happens for small airports A few shops that mainly sell local food and wine a very small duty free and a couple of bars It also features a small but comfortable lounge

Well organised for the transit process Airport service persons picked us up at the exit and allocated us in a special area There are free services for water wifi access and breakfast A lady registers and reminds each of the customers in the waiting area for boarding Very good experience

I flew from and to Varna Airport in April The airport is good but the lounges were closed early in the morning There is only duty free shop and the prices there are good One bad thing is that boarding the plane is always by bus otherwise it is a good experience

A very small airport no airways you walk on the tarmac to the terminal if like most people you need to buy a visa there is a line manned by only people and no organization at all then the customs man grunts at you or makes you open everything but then you are out and in one of the most beautiful places on earth

On June airport started renovation of taxiways as well as the installation of a new apron The inside of the airport is very clean it is easy to orientate the construction of a new terminal will begin The runway lighting is bad but will also be updated soon I very much hope that everything will be fine and that it will be easier and safer to travel

Waco Regional is not a bad airport overall They only have one flight which is to Dallas but I have heard rumors that United Express is resuming flights to Houston The reason I have given it stars is because their flights are always delayed or late My advice to travelers flying into Waco is to have patience The baggage claim takes a while The car rental facility is not bad for a small town Overall I think the airport shows good quality
The new terminal is really fresh and at the domestic departure some airlines merge in the same area and you can check in at any queue Everything looks good

Windhoek is a small airport with an increasing number of flights Facilities are limited but everything you need is there and seemed sufficient for numbers passing through Arriving early departing late on Air Namibia fromto FRA arrival took less than an hour and departing security was a reasonable time Staff were efficient and friendly Much easier to pass through than major airports

Winnipeg to Abbotsford I flew with Swoop for the first time and I absolutely loved it There were no delays and Winnipeg airport was not busy The signs were easy to follow Airport crew were very friendly

I departed on th April and was lucky to make my flight I was part of a tour group and as there were many groups trying to leave at the same time and not enough check in staff to process the travelers I made my flight with minutes to spare

Last time I was in Xian Xianyang airport was in I have visited many times before There was always a Scrum outside the airport building for tickets and to board the airport buses for downtown Returned this year a lot has changed with the airport and getting tickets for the buses You now go to a ticket booth inside the building Then a waiting room for your respective bus What an improvement

An hour delay no apologies nor explanations Quite some occasional turbulences again no word from the cockpit What compensated the whole flight was the incredible good seat pitch and the round of drinks and a cookie definitely much better than what some selfproclaimed fullservice airlines deliver

Excellent flight good service with hearty meal starter main course dessert tea and coffee Duty service on board A generous pitch for economy class seats Note the delay at departure due to the closure of Orly airport and the flights diverted to Paris CDG

Johannesburg to St Denis Service like it was years ago professional attentive amenity kit handed out on a hour flight and the quality and quantity of the catering Ive not seen for years Thoroughly recommended

Paris to Reunion Air Austral is a fairly good airline The seat layout of the Airbus A was xx The leg room was not too bad Inflight entertainment was good and worked well Cabin service was average but generally fine The flight was on time

Flew on four separate legs within Myanmar and found them to be surprisingly good You dont normally expect catering on flights of under an hour but there was something on all segments Arrived in good time at Heho Airport for a flight to Yangon and they automatically put me on to an earlier departure There is a certain amount of third world amateurism about the boarding process but it all seemed to work
Chiang Mai to Yangon return and pleasantly surprised by the standard fairly new aircraft and meal service for minute flight Flight attendants were somewhat offhand Reasonable leg room in economy
Francistown Johannesburg September Good short flight efficiently run with good crew On time and no problems

Yangon to Mandalay Really good flight the seating was and actual seat numbers given on boarding pass plenty of space even at inflight catering offered light snack and good coffee Nothing to worry about despite ATR aircraft type and would definitely fly again

Easy check in at Gatwick They use the club rooms lounge which was fine Prompt boarding and beverage served One hour delay managed well by crew who served further drinks and snacks During flight beverage good There is a strong emphasis on fish in meals It was fine I just dont like fish Slept well on lie flat mattress topper was very good Breakfast good their orange juice was excellent Easy disembarking and luggage off quickly
The aircraft was on time from Manchester and on the return journey from Lourdes Bartres the aircraft left early The staff were a bit distant the food good overall OK

We were totally amazed by their services since none of us have ever heard of this airline The trip was arranged by the travel agency who arranged our tour Even during a short trip they provided us gourmet sandwiches and a warm cookie while beverages was served twice which is far much better than what we experienced from those larger airlines How we wish they can cover more routes
Melbourne to Nouma Surprisingly very good airline and good business seat for a three hours flight Very good staff and very good product in business Among them Nikko Japanese whisky
Everything about the flight experience went well I was worried reading the other reviews but in the end it was a very positive experience The terminal in El Nido is also very good

From the moment I boarded the crew exuded warmth and professionalism Junu and Reeza provided assistance wherever needed The inflight service was impeccable Bhoomi and Nisha managed the meal service efficiently The crew went above and beyond to ensure passenger comfort Whether it was providing extra blankets assisting with luggage or attending to special requests they were attentive and proactive Their kindness and willingness to help truly stood out Looking forward to flying with Akasa Air again

Cusco to Uyuni via La Paz My experience with Amaszonas was good actually Luckily the weather was in my favor too Initially I was a little skeptical after reading reviews but the trip was pretty smooth Flight was on the smaller side although not as small as people had initially mentioned Theres about to rows of seats and I was comfortable THe only thing is they board like minutes prior to departure which makes you a little nervous but the trip as such was okay

AMSAUAAMS I regularly fly ArkeFly between Europe and the Antilles and what a huge difference between the old and worn with barely enough space to breathe and the new with more spacious seats PTV and a so much better experience Furthermore the crew seems to enjoy the Dreamliner much more and even smiles are being made Also the time of always being delayed also seems to be over ArkeFly improved a lot with the Dreamliner and I even prefer Arkefly above KLM now as long as they fly the Dreamliner
I just experienced Asiana Airlines Business class food delicious flight attendants good service I give stars because flight is delay minutes and does not have wiFi

Small company but very friendly and efficient staff All passengers treated as business class travelers even though Atlantic Airways only offers one class economy Small planes Bea and Airbus but the comfort is all right for the short trips between Scandinavian countries Faroe Islands and Britain
CPHFAE return new aircraft on time friendly and smiling FA snack alcoholic nonalcoholic beverage served

Da Nang to Da Lat The checkout process was smooth Although there was a minutes delay due to the late arrival of the airplane once we boarded everything went on well The legroom was not that cramped I found the crew service even better than Vietnam Airlines flight I flew to Da Nang several days before So I might fly this airline again on my future visit to Vietnam

The flights are frequently delayed but its a small price to pay for clean aircraft ample seat pitch kind crew and the lowest fares My flight from Melbourne to Kuala Lumpur was on an A with plenty of legroom and good meals Online checkin yields a good seat for me and their use of KLIA T makes for an easy and relaxing journey

I take this airline from Hangzhou to Lisbon th May The food is good taste and various I have stony insomnia problem and i did not pay attention and lost my sleeping medicine into rubbish I told the air hostess she is warmheart and patiently helped me search the rubbish patiently almost taking hours and finally searched my sleeping medicine I am thankful for this
Kuala Lumpur to Pangkor Island return This is the most pleasant way of flying for those who love airplanes

Dhaka to Singapore Good food good seating and comparatively better ground services at Dhaka Staff on board are just okay though My travel ticket price was high though Worst inflight entertainment service
Short trip Arlanda to Helsinki Very nice people working on board Cold but nice meal nice experience
Tried Premium Economy class and I was surprised about the seat quality and onboard meals This class also included amenity kit which I appreciate Cabin crew nicely handle my yo child
We had a challenge with checking due to a third party error Even so Sarah was super kind and efficient She made us feel at ease and resolved the issues we had promptly Thanks again

KIVKBPODS Both flights were codeshared with Aerosvit but operated by Dniproavia planes KIVKBP Embraer that has seen better days KBPODS plane was an oldlooking Boeing Service onboard was good Offered drinks and a double sandwich despite both flights being under hr Flights departed on time They almost lost my luggage on the first flight as it was sent to connecting flights but were able to locate it relatively quickly and hand it back Overall a relatively good experience for the price paid

Palonegro to Cucuta with Easyfly Was put on this flight after Satena cancelled one of the legs I was hesitant since I had to make it to CUC that day The JS are quite small yet efficient planes Easyfly ground staff at Palonegro was quite helpful and professional Flight was smooth and punctual No complaints at all Despite the short duration of the flight minutes refreshments were offered Would consider it if needed

Moscow to Thessaloniki I usually use this company in my trips to Moscow Even if i was wondering about this new company that they use leasing airplanes i tried it and i want to say just one thing these are our lovely Greeks Every trip is small party specially when the destination is a Greek airport People are drinking free alcohol Greek wine they are eating and are enjoying their trip Staff is very goodThey use more than languages
Milan Bergamo to Tirana Lot of comfort reclining seat big leg space cheap food prices on board cabin crew very professional Flight on time

Its nothing too special but it was definitely an affordable price The inflight food and beverage was comprised of a juice box and bottled water The customer service is ok There was in issue with the website where it continually declined my card but it actually charged my card every time I attempted meaning with four attempts there were in false charges Fortunately the customer service could be reached by WhatsApp and they were able to refund me for the imaginary flight bookings

Dusseldorf to Berlin Eurowings flight operated by Germanwings EW Flight had a slight delay of minutes Flight was smooth and good Seat was fine with enough legroom Food and drinks for puchase crew was just average

Berlin to Dusseldorf Eurowings flight operated by Germanwings This A was a different configuration then the first flight Legroom was less and was just enough for me m crew were smiling and good The flight delayed by minutes

I fainted in the flight and where some crew may have panicked in some cases this crew handled the situation very well Provided me with all the necessary assistance and first aid and was very kind and humble till the end
